title: Sawdong Ka Mariang (All Around Creation / Nature Hymn)
description: Celebratory nature poem and melody describing the waterfalls, limestone caverns, and living wildlife of Sohra.

khasi: Sawdong ka mariang ka sawa ko sur,
Ki sim ki pah ha pnat ki dieng,
Ka lyer khriat ka wan na lum,
Ka kynud ia ka jingrwai ka jingim.
english: All around creation the melody resounds,
The birds call sweet notes from leafy boughs,
The fresh cool breeze descends from high peaks,
Humming the timeless song of life.
